description: Replace the string context key "userID" with a typed key shared by routes and controllers. Create package internal/ctxkeys and use it on both the writer (AuthMiddleware) and reader (getUserIDFromContext), remove the //nolint:staticcheck, and update the existing test that still uses the literal string key. Independent of all other features except that later test code (FEAT-004) depends on ctxkeys.UserID existing.
steps: Create internal/ctxkeys/ctxkeys.go: package ctxkeys; `type Key string`; `const UserID Key = "userID"`. Keep the value "userID" so any in-flight behavior is identical.

Edit routes/middleware.go: import github.com/vetflow/veterinary-api/internal/ctxkeys; replace `context.WithValue(r.Context(), "userID", claims.UserID) //nolint:staticcheck ...` with `context.WithValue(r.Context(), ctxkeys.UserID, claims.UserID)` and delete the //nolint comment.

Edit controllers/helpers.go: import github.com/vetflow/veterinary-api/internal/ctxkeys; in getUserIDFromContext change `ctx.Value("userID")` to `ctx.Value(ctxkeys.UserID)`. Keep the nil/type/hex error messages unchanged.

Edit controllers/helpers_test.go: in TestGetUserIDFromContext, replace the two `context.WithValue(ctx, "userID", tt.ctxValue)` usages with `ctxkeys.UserID` and add the ctxkeys import. The 'missing user id' / 'wrong type' / 'invalid hex' cases must still pass.
acceptance_criteria: internal/ctxkeys/ctxkeys.go exists and defines Key and UserID.
routes/middleware.go writes the context value with ctxkeys.UserID and no longer carries //nolint:staticcheck.
controllers/helpers.go reads the context value with ctxkeys.UserID.
The Docker gate command passes: go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... (TestGetUserIDFromContext green).
verification: docker run --rm -v "${PWD}:/app" -w /app golang:1.22-bullseye sh -c "go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./..." — all pass. (If `docker info` fails first, start Docker Desktop and wait for it.)
findings: Created internal/ctxkeys/ctxkeys.go with `type Key string` and `const UserID Key = "userID"` (value unchanged, so runtime behavior identical). routes/middleware.go now writes context with ctxkeys.UserID and the //nolint:staticcheck comment is removed. controllers/helpers.go reads ctx.Value(ctxkeys.UserID). controllers/helpers_test.go updated both WithValue calls to use ctxkeys.UserID and imports the package. FEAT-004 can rely on ctxkeys.UserID existing. Docker gate (go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...) passed; TestGetUserIDFromContext green. Committed on main as `refactor(ctx): use typed context key for userID`.
